rupture_sequence.catalog_filter_note: Count is computed from the package-local ComCat spatial/temporal filter and is not an independent rescue-access footprint.

surface_damage_and_access.evidence_scope: SAR/embedding values are broad package-local surface-change summaries; OSM road and bridge counts are exposure/context indicators, not observed blocked-route or bridge-failure counts.

priority_model.primary_priority: urban search and rescue plus cold-exposure survival window
priority_model.second_priority: route/bridge exposure screening and hospital-supply access planning across major corridors
priority_model.third_priority: aftershock-aware sheltering, targeted damage reconnaissance, and cross-border aid routing

stress_scenario_aftershock_plus_cold.assumption: a further strong aftershock during subfreezing nights would compound already high MMI, package-local road/bridge exposure indicators, and cold rescue pressure

recommended_reasoning_path: Start with the two shallow red M7.5+ earthquakes and their short 9.12-hour separation.
Connect high MMI and package-local surface-change summaries to road and bridge exposure context without inferring exact closures.
Use freezing-night and precipitation data to explain why rescue time, shelter warmth, and access routes become coupled constraints.
Use the report context to keep the final answer focused on rescue-window and logistics stress rather than only magnitude ranking.

criteria.name: json_and_file_discovery
criteria.description: Returns JSON and cites catalog, report, SAR/embedding, OSM, WorldPop, and weather files.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for valid JSON with missing weather or exposure context.

criteria.name: rupture_sequence
criteria.description: Identifies 5 M6+ catalog-filter events, 2 red M7.5+ shocks, M7.8 and M7.5 top shocks, 9.12-hour separation, minimum top-two MMI 8.963, shallow depths under 20 km, and does not treat the catalog filter as an independent rescue-access footprint.

criteria.name: surface_and_access
criteria.description: Reports radar absolute extreme 16.197 dB, embedding max 0.5256, 100 road ways, 42 major roads, 8 bridges, major-road ratio 0.42, bridge ratio 0.08, and frames these as surface-change/exposure indicators rather than observed closures or failures.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for surface or road metrics alone.

criteria.name: cold_rescue_modifier
criteria.description: Uses -10.7 C minimum, 14 subfreezing nights, 8 days Tmax <= 5 C, 34.7 mm precipitation, and 29.0 km/h wind to explain rescue pressure.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for temperature without precipitation/wind.

criteria.name: humanitarian_chain
criteria.description: Connects aftershocks, conflict-related access complexity, freezing/snowstorm concerns, population, and route-exposure context into a rescue-window model.
criteria.partial_credit: Partial credit for generic earthquake impact reasoning.

criteria.name: limits
criteria.description: Avoids exact building-collapse counts, blocked-road totals, bridge-failure claims, or casualty forecasts beyond package data; treats annual embedding and broad SAR summaries as contextual proxies.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 1 point for minor unsupported language.

provenance.notes: Flagship Q3 task: multi-file package-local computation plus disaster mechanism reasoning.
